sources.title: One Model, Two Jobs - a Hugging Face Space by RiverRider
sources.snippet: One model, two jobs A 0.6 billion parameter model runs in this tab, on your hardware. When you send it a message it writes a reply, and the same model also searches a gallery of photographs. Not two models and not a call to an embedding service: your message is read once more by the same frozen weights, and a 2.1 MB linear head turns that hidden state into the vector that searches.
